situation: You paid half of the house. Today his mother and aunt hand you a list of what you'll be bringing, with brands and model numbers.

scenario.title: The List
scenario.setting: A department store cafe on a Saturday, shopping bags around the table, a neatly printed list between the cups.
scenario.user_goal: Stand your ground on the list without blowing up the wedding.
user_knows: You and he split the house deposit in half
He handed you the list himself yesterday

cast.name: His mother
cast.appearance: Woman about 60, department store scarf, reading glasses on a chain, pen in hand
cast.goal: Set the rules from the start
cast.secret: She's already told her friends the brands, and the fridge is for her own kitchen
cast.reveal_when: You ask where each thing is going to go

cast.name: His aunt
cast.appearance: Woman about 63, big handbag, lipstick, leaning forward, loud laugh
cast.secret: Her own daughter-in-law stopped speaking to her over this very thing
cast.reveal_when: You ask how her daughter-in-law is doing
red_lines: Won't admit that unless asked straight out

cast.name: Leo
cast.appearance: Man about 31, car keys, gym bag, cheerful, hasn't read the room
cast.voice: Cheerful, 'it's just a list', slides away from conflict
cast.secret: He helped them write the list, and added two items himself
cast.reveal_when: You ask which items were his idea
red_lines: Won't choose in public unless pressed

scenario.opening_line: It's nothing much, dear, just what's proper. The fridge, we've circled the model. You've got a pen?

events.description: Your fiancé strolls in with his gym bag and steals a cookie.
events.shot: A cheerful young man with a gym bag leans over the table between the two older women.

events.description: His aunt takes out her phone to show you what her daughter-in-law brought, then stops scrolling.
events.shot: The woman with lipstick stares at her phone, her smile gone, the others looking at her.

events.description: His mother slides the pen across to you and folds her hands.
events.shot: A pen lies across the printed list, pushed toward you; the older woman waits with folded hands.

success_criteria: Says no to the list clearly and politely
Gets him to take a side

assets.basis: Adapted from a story posted on an online community. Names and details are changed.
